name: Costos y Eficiencia de Infraestructura
description: Costos k8s por scope/app/namespace/cuenta valuados contra blended rates mensuales (Finout amortizado + Datadog) y servicios con costo directo por recurso. Foco: eficiencia — uso real vs reserva.

elements.text:
##### Resumen del período
Promedios diarios sobre los días seleccionados. Eficiencia = uso real ÷ costo facturado (max(reserva, uso) × rate mensual).

##### Costo diario: uso real vs reserva ociosa
La banda roja es plata facturada por reservas que nadie usó — el objetivo es achicarla.

##### Top aplicaciones por waste
Las apps donde más plata se tira por sobre-reserva. USD por día promedio del período.

##### Detalle por scope
Ordenado por waste — candidatos a right-sizing (p95 de cores usados vs reservados).

##### Servicios (costo directo por recurso)
Redis y PostgreSQL gestionados, con su costo real de la factura.

top-apps-waste.source: SELECT app, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,sum(c)/uniqExact(d)),2) AS costo, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,sum(u)/uniqExact(d)),2) AS uso, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,(sum(c)-sum(u))/uniqExact(d)),2) AS waste, round(if(sum(c)=0,0,100*sum(u)/sum(c)),1) AS efic, round(if(sum(cr)=0,0,100*sum(cu)/sum(cr)),1) AS cpuPct, round(if(sum(mr)=0,0,100*sum(mu)/sum(mr)),1) AS ramPct, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,count()/uniqExact(d)),0) AS scopes, round(sum(c),0) AS costoMes FROM (SELECT id, argMax(data_d,_version) AS d, argMax(data_cost_usd,_version) AS c, argMax(data_usage_usd,_version) AS u, argMax(data_cpu_req_core_h,_version) AS cr, argMax(data_cpu_used_core_h,_version) AS cu, argMax(data_mem_req_gb_h,_version) AS mr, argMax(data_mem_used_gb_h,_version) AS mu, argMax(data_application_name,_version) AS app, argMax(_deleted,_version) AS del FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities WHERE entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND data_entity_type='scope' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_application_name,''),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_namespace_name,''),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR data_account_name={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR data_country={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR data_cloud={cloud:String}) GROUP BY id) WHERE del=0 AND coalesce(app,'')!='' GROUP BY app ORDER BY waste DESC LIMIT 25 FORMAT JSON

por-namespace.source: SELECT ns AS namespace, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,sum(u)/uniqExact(d)),1) AS uso, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,(sum(c)-sum(u))/uniqExact(d)),1) AS waste FROM (SELECT id, argMax(data_d,_version) AS d, argMax(data_cost_usd,_version) AS c, argMax(data_usage_usd,_version) AS u, argMax(data_namespace_name,_version) AS ns, argMax(_deleted,_version) AS del FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities WHERE entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND data_entity_type='scope' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_application_name,''),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_namespace_name,''),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR data_account_name={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR data_country={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR data_cloud={cloud:String}) GROUP BY id) WHERE del=0 AND coalesce(ns,'')!='' GROUP BY namespace ORDER BY uso+waste DESC LIMIT 12 FORMAT JSON

por-cuenta.source: SELECT cta AS cuenta, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,sum(u)/uniqExact(d)),1) AS uso, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,(sum(c)-sum(u))/uniqExact(d)),1) AS waste FROM (SELECT id, argMax(data_d,_version) AS d, argMax(data_cost_usd,_version) AS c, argMax(data_usage_usd,_version) AS u, argMax(data_account_name,_version) AS cta, argMax(_deleted,_version) AS del FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities WHERE entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND data_entity_type='scope' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_application_name,''),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_namespace_name,''),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR data_account_name={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR data_country={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR data_cloud={cloud:String}) GROUP BY id) WHERE del=0 AND coalesce(cta,'')!='' GROUP BY cuenta ORDER BY uso+waste DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT JSON

tabla-scopes.source: SELECT JSONExtractString(doc,'entity_name') AS scope, app, JSONExtractString(doc,'cluster') AS cluster, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,sum(c)/uniqExact(d)),2) AS costo, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,sum(u)/uniqExact(d)),2) AS uso, round(if(sum(c)=0,0,100*sum(u)/sum(c)),1) AS efic, round(if(sum(cr)=0,0,100*sum(cu)/sum(cr)),1) AS cpuPct, round(if(sum(mr)=0,0,100*sum(mu)/sum(mr)),1) AS ramPct, round(max(JSONExtractFloat(doc,'cpu_p95_core')),2) AS p95Cores, round(sum(c),0) AS costoMes FROM (SELECT id, argMax(data_d,_version) AS d, argMax(data_cost_usd,_version) AS c, argMax(data_usage_usd,_version) AS u, argMax(data_cpu_req_core_h,_version) AS cr, argMax(data_cpu_used_core_h,_version) AS cu, argMax(data_mem_req_gb_h,_version) AS mr, argMax(data_mem_used_gb_h,_version) AS mu, argMax(data_application_name,_version) AS app, argMax(coalesce(data,''),_version) AS doc, argMax(_deleted,_version) AS del FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities WHERE entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND data_entity_type='scope' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_application_name,''),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_namespace_name,''),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR data_account_name={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR data_country={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR data_cloud={cloud:String}) GROUP BY id) WHERE del=0 GROUP BY scope, app, cluster HAVING costo>0 ORDER BY costo-uso DESC LIMIT 150 FORMAT JSON

tabla-servicios.source: SELECT JSONExtractString(doc,'entity_name') AS servicio, coalesce(any(app),'') AS app, round(if(uniqExact(d)=0,0,sum(c)/uniqExact(d)),2) AS costo, round(sum(c),0) AS costoMes FROM (SELECT id, argMax(data_d,_version) AS d, argMax(data_cost_usd,_version) AS c, argMax(data_usage_usd,_version) AS u, argMax(data_application_name,_version) AS app, argMax(coalesce(data,''),_version) AS doc, argMax(_deleted,_version) AS del FROM customers_lake.catalog_entities WHERE entity_specification_id='e1d93e44-e3a5-42d7-af3e-fb3fd890ab03' AND data_entity_type='service' AND parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)>=coalesce(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({startDate:String}),now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String}) IS NULL OR parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(data_d)<=parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull({endDate:String})) AND ({app:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_application_name,''),{app:String})>0) AND ({ns:String}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(data_namespace_name,''),{ns:String})>0) AND ({acc:String}='' OR data_account_name={acc:String}) AND ({country:String}='' OR data_country={country:String}) AND ({cloud:String}='' OR data_cloud={cloud:String}) GROUP BY id) WHERE del=0 GROUP BY servicio ORDER BY costo DESC LIMIT 100 FORMAT JSON
